primary_title: Stabilin-1 mediates phagocytosis of apoptotic cells through a GULP-dependent mechanism
decision_basis: Stabilin-1 cytoplasmic NPxF/Y-tail interaction with the GULP1 PTB domain and GULP-dependent phagocytosis are supported by cell-based binding and knockdown assays
limitations_preserved: Preserve the NPxF/Y motif and apoptotic/efferocytosis context; cytoplasmic adaptor association without a kinase relay or SCI inference.

primary_title: The phagocytic receptor stabilin-2 mediates apoptotic cell clearance through its NPXY motif and the adaptor GULP
decision_basis: Stabilin-2 NPXY-tail interaction with GULP1 and GULP-dependent aged-red-cell engulfment are supported by FRET/biochemical binding and loss- and gain-of-function assays
limitations_preserved: Preserve the NPXY motif and aged/apoptotic-cell clearance context; do not duplicate PtdSer-to-STAB2 or infer universal signaling.

primary_title: GULP1 is a novel partner of the HDL receptor SR-BI and regulates apoptotic cell phagocytosis
decision_basis: SR-BI C-terminal tail association with GULP1 and GULP-dependent Rac1/MAPK and apoptotic-cell phagocytosis are supported by yeast two-hybrid, cell-free binding, co-IP and knockdown assays
limitations_preserved: Preserve the Sertoli/apoptotic spermatogenic-cell model; do not extrapolate to HDL-receptor function or SCI.

primary_title: CD44 binds to ERM proteins through a positively charged amino acid cluster in its cytoplasmic domain
decision_basis: CD44 cytoplasmic-tail mapping and ezrin-binding-site mutants support direct tail-adaptor association and membrane localization in human melanoma cells
limitations_preserved: Supports adhesion-receptor/cytoskeletal coupling; tail mutations did not disrupt hyaluronan binding, and no kinase relay or SCI inference is made.

primary_title: Molecular cloning and expression of a cDNA encoding the high affinity receptor for leukotriene B4
decision_basis: BLT1 cloning and expression demonstrate leukotriene B4 binding, calcium/IP3 signaling, cAMP inhibition and pertussis-toxin-sensitive chemotaxis
limitations_preserved: Preserve BLT1/LTB4R1 subtype and human leukocyte/heterologous context; distinguish BLT1 from BLT2 and no SCI inference.

primary_title: 7alpha,25-dihydroxycholesterol is an endogenous ligand for the G protein-coupled receptor EBI2
decision_basis: 7alpha,25-dihydroxycholesterol activates GPR183/EBI2 in receptor-expressing cells and controls immune-cell migration in receptor- and Ch25h-dependent systems
limitations_preserved: Preserve the oxysterol form and GPR183-specific immune-cell migration context; no terminal-TF or SCI inference.

primary_title: Lysophosphatidic acid and sphingosine 1-phosphate stimulate G protein-linked receptors
decision_basis: S1P activates EDG1/S1PR1 in transfected cells with radioligand binding, calcium/IP3, pertussis-toxin-sensitive cAMP inhibition and MAPK responses
limitations_preserved: Preserve S1PR1/EDG1-specific Gi/o context; S1P also has receptor-independent intracellular effects, and no SCI inference is made.

primary_title: A novel eicosanoid receptor activated by 5-oxo-ETE and OXE receptor signaling in human eosinophils
decision_basis: 5-oxo-ETE activates OXER1/OXE in Gi-linked receptor assays and drives pertussis-toxin-sensitive granulocyte chemotaxis
limitations_preserved: Preserve human OXER1 nomenclature and granulocyte context; mouse orthology is unresolved, with no SCI inference.
